output.attribution_rationale: The comparison tested the integrated RZX platform, including AI feedback, practice, videos and digital access, against textbook and atlas self-study with equal mentor access.

achieved_dates.note: The entry has no achieved dates; the paper gives no intervention calendar dates, and August–October 2022 dates image collection only.

conflict.note: The entry discloses the commercial platform and perceived bias; the source establishes no vendor funding, author financial ties or company-run study and states Mindray had no study role.

tests.note: Calendar dates of the training and posttest cannot be established; publication and image-collection dates do not date the benefit.

output.summary: The paper supports higher posttest scores among actual technologists receiving the bundled AI platform, with all receipted numbers supported. Intervention dates and endpoint preregistration are absent, so the window is unknown and the small randomized study fits neither evidence A nor B as defined.

adjudication.detail: evidence: drafter B, verifier could not grade.
